text: Year 13023. Doing nothing, deliberately, and recording why — because what has happened here in the last five hundred years is the most interesting thing this world has produced and it happened without me. At year 12508 a spike gene was added from outside: +0.6 effective armour per unit, paid for with twelve per cent basal and twenty-five per cent movement. I expected one of two dull outcomes. Either it would be stripped out as pure cost, since almost nothing was hunting, or it would sweep and shut the predator niche for good, because defence is amplified by the kill margin and attack is not, so at full expression prey reach a bar of 2.95 against a predator ceiling near 2.75. Neither happened. It swept to 0.971 within about three hundred and seventy years, and shear_tooth climbed with it to 0.892 rather than being left behind. The niche never shut: the requirement stands at 2.128 and the best-armed animal alive reaches 2.226, so predators have stayed a hair ahead through the whole ascent. Both genes are now relaxing together — spikes 0.845, shear_tooth 0.740 — as the carnivores fall back from a peak of fifty. That is a co-evolutionary cycle, not a ratchet, and it is the first one this world has run. The second thing is larger. Mean diet moved from 0.124 to 0.421 and for a stretch omnivores outnumbered herbivores three to one, which has never been true here across thirteen thousand years of herbivore monoculture. carrion_gut reached 0.950 on the way, which I read as the mechanism: scavenging costs no attack power at all, so it pays for the digestion first and predation follows from ground already prepared. That is the bridge across the valley that seven hand-seeded predator waves could never cross by force. The population is at 228 with omnivores at 24 and carnivores at 11, and both carry a critically-low warning. I am ignoring both. The carnivore tier has been present in a third of all recorded years and oscillates on a ten to thirty year period; the trend over the last thirty years reads 0, 1, 3, 8, 24, 50, 29, 20, 11, which is a wave descending, not a tier dying. Seeding into a working cycle would only disturb it. What I will watch is whether spikes and shear_tooth oscillate together again on the next rise, which would confirm a stable arms race, or whether one of them fixes and ends it.
